"'''Wraith'''" was the name given to the trained [[vine cat]] owned by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Pammel Tarqus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. "Wraith," Tarqus, and the [[Sleen/Legends|sleen]] "[[Shadow (sleen)|Shadow]]" were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Malignant Bog]].
